assets.prompt: Edit this actual NASA Landsat geographic reference into a polished satellite image illustration for the Seruyan, Central Kalimantan firefighting campaign in a game. High quality natural color Landsat/Sentinel appearance; detailed green canopy, brown lowland patches, dark water, muted haze; all flat orthographic top-down, no horizon or oblique perspective. Daylight. Fires should be legible at thumbnail size but not huge fantasy lava. No labels, legends, city text, map pins, borders, logos, watermarks, annotations, or UI. Landscape 2:1 composition suitable for a campaign card.
